description: This file defines the main React component 'App' for a weather application UI. It manages state, handles user interactions for searching weather data, and renders various UI elements including a search bar, weather cards, forecast list, and banners. It also manages fallback to demo data if live API calls fail or are not configured.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the weather app UI, manages state, and handles data fetching and user interactions.

methods.name: handleSearch
methods.description: Asynchronous function to perform weather data fetch based on user query, with fallback to demo data on failure or if API is not configured.
